7.1.4.2.1 Direct gatewaying
[SWS_PduR_00551]
Upstream requirements: SRS_GTW_06026, SRS_GTW_06029, SRS_GTW_06124
⌈The <DstLoTp>_Transmit shall be called on each destination of transport protocol
module(s) within the PduR_<SrcLoTp>RxIndication, if result is E_OK.⌋
[SWS_PduR_00697]
Upstream requirements: SRS_GTW_06026, SRS_GTW_06124
⌈For Single Frame transmission, if PduR_<DstLoTp>CopyTxData is called with
Tp
DataState
TP_CONFPENDING or TP_DATACONF or when the RetryInfoType
pointer is NULL, the PDU Router shall copy SduLength bytes of data. If not enough
data is avilalble, the PDU Router shall return BUFREQ_E_BUSY without copying any
data.⌋
[SWS_PduR_00705]
Upstream requirements: SRS_GTW_06026, SRS_GTW_06124, SRS_GTW_06105
⌈For Single Frame transmission, if PduR_<DstLoTp>CopyTxData is called with
Tp
DataState
TP_DATARETRY, the PDU Router shall set back the current position by
Tx TpData Cnt bytes and copy SduLength bytes of data. If the PDU Router cannot
set back the position as requested, it shall return BUFREQ_E_NOT_OK without changing
the current position or copying any data. If, after resetting the current position, not
enough data is available for copying, the PDU Router shall return BUFREQ_E_BUSY
without copying any data.⌋
